ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: AFRICA (Same as Anthropology 417) NOTE: Students wishing to participate in this seminar will be required to also register and participate in MUS 450, Section S2 (Mande Drumming). Tentative plans are being made for the ensemble to have a summer program in Western Africa. Ensemble participation is required to be considered for the summer program.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Voice or Instrumental Music or Music Composition or Music History or Open Studies or Music Education or Music or Musicology or Jazz Performance major(s).
